card.name: First digit of two-digit numbers
card.fires_on: The first digit (or a 0) of a two-digit number in dosing and handling instructions, such as 10 cm2, 20% body surface area, 45° angle, 48 hours, 90 minutes. It responds when the number is followed by a unit that is about to appear.

modes.label: Hours or minutes limits
modes.description: First digit of a time limit for use or infusion, such as within 4(8) hours or over 90 minutes.
modes.example: Diluted VIMIZIM solution must be used within <<4>>8 hours, inclusive of total infusion time

modes.label: Area, percent, angle, percentile
modes.description: A digit inside a number for application area, body surface percent, injection angle or percentile.
modes.example: Apply a thin layer of OPZELURA topically twice daily to affected areas of up to 2<<0>>% body surface area.

card.writes: It seems to add little beyond a push toward units and quantity words that follow a number, with no clear effect.
